introduce-description:
We were established in 2010 in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, 
 as a green enterprise focused on environmental sustainability. 
 We specialize in the recycling and reuse of tungsten carbide, high-speed steel, and tungsten sludge. 
 With over 20 years of experience in material recycling, we understand the value of resources and the importance of reuse. 
 With our professional technical team, we efficiently and effectively recycle, classify, and process various types of metal waste to ensure the quality and purity of regenerated products. 
 We adhere to a quality-first principle, strictly controlling the quality of recycled materials to meet customer needs and standards. 
 At the same time, we provide professional recycling services at reasonable prices, allowing customers to obtain high-quality products while achieving greater economic benefits. 
 Our regenerated product offerings are diverse, including tungsten powder, tungsten carbide, and high-speed steel, to meet different customer needs. 
 We can also provide customized recycling solutions based on actual requirements. 
 We incorporate environmental protection principles into every aspect of material recycling to ensure that our product lifecycle remains eco-friendly, achieving sustainable green energy and environmental development.
With rich industry experience and a strong reputation, we have established long-term and stable partnerships with many domestic and international enterprises, becoming a reliable partner you can trust.
